boundaries: MAS is Adventure assembly/preparation tooling and does not become canonical Story, Adventure, Scene, Session, Quest, World, Character, Relationship, Investigation or Action/Event authority
CSW remains the pre-authoritative creative/storycraft workspace; MAS consumes explicit handoffs rather than duplicating CSW
CNI remains modular conditional-content runtime authority; MAS edits and packages CNI-governed content rather than creating a second runtime
MCS remains map/cartography authority, MCCS remains entity-presentation authoring authority, and MNCS remains NPC/creature generation/construction authority
MAS consumes accepted MNCS cast, group, population, persona, relationship, knowledge, ecology and behavior references rather than inventing a parallel Adventure-local NPC generator
prepared scenes, clues, encounters, rewards and timed events never silently become live-state occurrences
all imported/generated media resources preserve ARI identity/provenance/rights rules and authoring changes preserve D29 provenance
visibility filtering applies before search, counts, graph topology, diagnostics, optional-AI context and export
optional AI may suggest or draft but cannot silently incorporate, publish or mutate live state
MSAS is the strict planned successor after MAS-21 and consumes Adventure/Scene/session context without becoming Adventure or live-event authority
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected source/content/assets/UI expression are not copied
no paid/cloud Adventure provider is required for blocking workflows
no implementation authority until separately governed start
